html:
Survey feedback
Establish that they own a smartphone at the start
Age that they got a phone (potentially age they started using social media)
In the boredom relationship, I don't want to ask leading questions, some are a bit leading
Think about positive associations with boredom, i kind of get to that in the 3rd section, so it may not add too much. because i talk about the context of creativity in the next section
"do you feel like your phone use affects your ability to think creativity or affect your life" is a bit of a leading question
Maybe add an example to the question at the end of section 5 "Is there anything else you'd like to share about your relationship with boredom, idle time, or your phone?"
People may skip it
Overall good combo of qualitative and quantitative data, good mixture of questions, helps pinpoints insights, it will likely lead me somewhere, assuming i get a good response. It has good potential, hopefully leading to some interviews, longer discussion

Some other things
What other primary research could i do
Cultural probe
Read more into the design for behavioral change

just in terms of storytelling, i can make survey data and interviews really compelling, and theres way to frame that, but having people go out into the world and do some journalism or od some photo logging of behaviors, it creates more compelling data from an audience perspective, making the project more visually rich, the cultural probe would make it more interesting

And i would get a lot of different types of insights I wouldn't get from and interview, another type of data collection

Think about how i may conduct that experiment, who may i reach out to for participation in this

next steps
survey eidts
think about interviews and who i may interview
if i was to do some cultural probe what might that entail and what may i gather
read more into behavioral change
